Working Student in Data Science (m/w/x)
Siemens Aktiengesellschaft Österreich
Werkstudent | Teilzeit | mit Homeoffice | AI/ML Job | Data Science
ab 40.910 EUR / Jahr auf Vollzeit-Basis
Wien

You will help shape the future of AI by assisting with the development and deployment of scalable solutions while collaborating with domain experts to optimize data-focused offerings.

Anforderungen:
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or relevant discipline
- Foundational knowledge of statistics and machine learning
- Experience with timeseries data classification, anomaly detection, or forecasting
- Proficiency in Python and clean code writing
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Clear communication and insight sharing skills
- Interest in IoT data and machine learning challenges
- Awareness of agentic AI and RAG approaches (advantageous)
- Laufendes Studium erforderlich

Deine Aufgaben:
- Assist in building, testing, and maintaining AI solutions
- Collaborate with building technology experts to optimize data offerings
- Support the scalable deployment of AI solutions
- Work closely with data engineering and software development teams
- Contribute to real-world AI applications and product workflows
- Engage in cross-functional teamwork within a professional environment

Tools & Technologien: Python, Agentic AI, Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), IoT
Sprachen: Englisch verhandlungssicher

Deine Vorteile:
- Flexible working hours, uncomplicated home office regulation, home office flat rate
- Closed on window days, closed between Christmas and New Year
- Extensive development opportunities
- Canteen at the location

Werkstudent Data Platforms & Financial Services (m/w/x)
BearingPoint GmbH
Teilzeit | ab 2.550 EUR monatlich | Berufseinstieg | Wien

Standort: Wien | Anstellung: Teilzeit ab 20 Stunden | ab Oktober 2026

BearingPoint ist eine unabhängige Management- und Technologieberatung mit europäischen Wurzeln und globaler Reichweite, die Unternehmen mithilfe moderner Technologien transformiert. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen bei der Transformation, indem wir fundiertes Branchenwissen mit starken Kompetenzen in Strategie, Geschäftsprozessen, Technologie und KI kombinieren. Unsere Beraterteams arbeiten dabei in unterschiedlichsten Industrien - immer nah am Kunden.

Was wir bieten:
- Individuelle und aktive Karriereförderung unterstützt durch umfassende Trainingsprogramme
- Inspirierende Projekte an der Schnittstelle Consulting und IT in unterschiedlichen Branchen weltweit
- Kostenlose Psychologische Beratung via Instahelp, Essensgutscheine und Zuschuss zum Jobticket
- Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und zahlreiche zusätzliche Benefits
- Gleichberechtigte und integrative Kultur

Für diese Position als Werkstudent:in gilt ein Mindestgehalt von EUR 2.550,- brutto pro Monat (auf Vollzeitbasis).

Student Job (f/m/x) - Data & AI Automation (20-25 h/week)
Raiffeisen Bank International AG
Teilzeit | ab 2.619,73 EUR monatlich | Berufseinstieg | Homeoffice möglich | Wien

Join the Non-Financial Risk Tribe at RBI Group. We are expanding the use of data, automation, and AI to improve internal processes and efficiency across the organization.
To support these initiatives, we are looking for a working student with a strong interest in data, automation, and modern technologies. In this role, you will contribute to building automation solutions, supporting data workflows, and experimenting with AI tools in a practical environment.

At a glance:
- Starting date: as soon as possible
- Working hours: 20-25 h/week
- Location: 1030 Vienna

Your role with us on the team:
- Support the development of automation scripts and small internal tools (e.g. Python-based solutions)
- Assist in data preparation, transformation, and analysis
- Contribute to data pipelines and data flows using modern platforms (e.g. Databricks)
- Help build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for risk purposes
- Leverage AI/LLM tools to improve efficiency

Anforderungen:
- Ongoing studies in IT, Computer Science, Data Science or related technical field
- English fluency
- Strong interest in data, automation, and modern technologies
- Basic programming skills (preferably Python)
- Basic understanding of data handling and structured datasets (SQL is a plus)
- Analytical thinking and structured working style
- First experience with Power BI, Databricks, APIs, low-code tools or Git is a plus

Benefits: buddy system for onboarding, internal student networking, subsidized canteen meals, shopping vouchers, free museum tickets, sports offers.

AI & Data Engineer
solvistas GmbH
Level: Experienced | Employment Type: Part Time/Full Time | Contract Type: Permanent employment
Salary: from 3.267 EUR Gross/Month | Location: Linz, Vienna | Working Model: Hybrid, Onsite

In this role, you will develop data pipelines and implement AI solutions, automate ETL processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, and support cloud deployments on platforms like AWS or Azure.

Your role in the team:
- Implementation and integration of AI processes and data solutions for our clients
- Development and maintenance of data pipelines and interfaces, from the source to the application
- Development and automation of ETL/ELT processes (e.g., with Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or dbt)

Requirements:
- 2-3 years of professional experience in Data Engineering or AI Development
- Experience in developing automated ETL/ELT pipelines
- German language skills at level C1
- Bonus: Experience in Data Visualization (e.g., Power BI, Streamlit, Dash) and experience with MinIO S3 or comparable object storage solutions

Benefits: Food & Drink, Work-Life-Integration, Health, Fitness & Fun.

AI & ML Intern - Full Stack Developer (m/f/d)
Trench Austria GmbH
Vollzeit | ab 2.998 EUR monatlich | Berufserfahrung | Homeoffice möglich | Leonding

SENSE THE POWER - TOGETHER, WE MAKE A DIFFERENCE
The Trench Group is a globally leading provider of components and systems for high-voltage power transmission. We are a systemically important player in the energy transition and in shaping a sustainable energy future. With more than 100 years of experience, we use our instrument transformers, bushings and reactors to protect and connect the power grid. We operate worldwide with more than 2,500 employees at nine manufacturing sites and four regional sales hubs. Trench Austria is responsible for all global sales and R&D activities within the Group.

Part-time (from approx. 16h/week) or Full-time Internship

What you can expect:
- Work with cross-functional teams to identify and implement AI/ML opportunities
- Support the development, training, and implementation of machine learning models
- Analyze large datasets to gain business insights
- Document development processes and model results
- Present results to stakeholders using visualizations and reports
- Assist in developing and maintaining full-stack applications for AI dashboards and tools
- Help integrate front-end solutions with Azure-based backends
- Contribute to ensuring the performance, scalability, and security of our solutions
- Work closely with domain experts to turn business requirements into technical features

What you bring:
- Enrolled in or recently completed studies in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or a comparable field
- Good understanding of machine learning algorithms and methods
- Experience with programming languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, or Java
- An attractive benefits package
